_note: level_zoom: zoom at which a click starts to choose ADM1 and ADM2 units. The build never lets a value go below the minzoom of the boundary tiles of that level (ADM1 2, ADM2 4 at the time of writing): it prints a warning and raises it. world_zoom: below this zoom a click on the globe chooses the whole world. hidden_layers: layer_ids kept off the map from here, a temporary stand-in for display.map = false in the meta (the layer stays in the files, on /data and in the card values). fan_max: a place with more records than this opens as a list only, with no fan. default_view.country: an ISO3 code to open on a country, null for the world. type_colors: colour of a class by its value (for layers that colour by type, such as the power plants); a class not listed takes the palette by its place. point_shapes: shape of the point icons by the domain of the layer. status_styles: how a status field (or the count columns of a place) becomes a kind of icon: fill = works, pale = built but not working, hatch = under construction, outline = announced, q = shelved, x = cancelled; labels are working texts until [RES] gives the legend texts. status_styles.title/note/lines: legend texts of the Status block (RES, RES_texts_site_legend); a line is shown while one of its layers is on (and, if it has a kind, that kind is in use). Keys are layer_ids. index_card: texts of the territory card (RES_texts_INDEX r2 §3-4); layer_titles, title_fields, detail_fields are keys of the index fields.

status_styles.title: Status
status_styles.note: Each source has its own statuses; the lines below say how they are drawn.

lines.text: GEM: Built, not operating (mothballed or retired)
GEM: Shelved: suspended, or no progress for two years
Shelved and Cancelled include projects that GEM classes so itself after two or four years without observed progress.

Atlas of Data Center Politics: our copies of the Atlas tables give one status, “Operating / Construction”, for operating sites and sites under construction; both are drawn as Operating. Planned sites are drawn as Announced or planned, retired sites as Built, not operating.
Epoch AI: IT power in operation (Epoch AI's estimate)
Epoch AI: no IT power in operation yet. Epoch AI gives no status, so the site may be planned or under construction.

texts.card_basis_field: by the unit the record names
texts.card_basis_mixed: by the unit the record names, or by point

card_approximate.dc_atlas_points: Placed at a town point, not at the site: {n_approx} of {n}. Such a record may belong to a neighboring unit.
card_approximate.dc_epoch_points: Placed at a town point, not at the site: {n_approx} of {n}. Such a record may belong to a neighboring unit.
card_approximate.energy_plants_gem_units: Placed at GEM's approximate location: {n_approx} of {n}. Such a record may belong to a neighboring unit.
card_approximate.energy_plants_gem_tzsam_units: Placed at GEM's approximate location: {n_approx} of {n}. Such a record may belong to a neighboring unit.

texts.card_country_only: Counted for {country} only, with no unit below the country: {n}. The notes below say why.
texts.card_other_country_here: Listed by the source under another country, but lying here: {n}.
texts.card_other_country_away: Listed under {country}, but lying in another country of the frame: {n}.

card_zero.dc_atlas_points: No Atlas record names or lies in this unit. The Atlas may still miss data centers here.
card_zero.dc_epoch_points: No Epoch AI site. Epoch AI lists only the largest AI data centers.
card_zero.energy_plants_gem_units: No GEM plant above GEM's thresholds.
card_zero.energy_plants_gem_tzsam_units: No GEM plant above GEM's thresholds.

card_unit_note.ambiguous_name: The county the record names shares its name with an independent city
card_unit_note.connecticut: Connecticut: the Atlas gives former counties
card_unit_note.region_not_matched: The region the record gives is missing or not a unit of the frame, and there is no point
card_unit_note.no_unit_near: The point is more than 22.2 km from every unit of its country
card_unit_note.no_point: No point to place the record by
card_unit_note.point_in_other_country: Listed by the source under another country
card_unit_note.region_only: The record names a region, not a department

aggregations_labels.blocks: GEM generating units, and capacity, by type and status
aggregations_labels.stations: GEM plants with at least one unit here (not additive across units)

field_labels.power_class: By size class (classes are not added up as MW)

texts.totals_note: Counted by the website from {index_file} ({version}). Only records of one layer are added, and GEM capacity only within one type and one status.
texts.loading: Loading the records of this unit…
texts.failed: Could not read the territory index.
texts.card_level_missing_adm1: {country} has no first-level units (such as states, provinces or regions) in the boundary frame of this version, so records are counted for the country only.
texts.card_level_missing_adm2: {country} has no second-level units (such as counties or departments) in the boundary frame of this version; this is the smallest unit in which records are counted.
